# Issuance Guide

## Goal
To create a minimum time (5, 10, 15 mins) guide for users to understand how to use Inji Certify to issue the first credential.

## Problem
The resource github repo, github repo docs, video respurces in the Inji Certify docs has Local Setup Guide, Deployment Guide, but none of these has bundled it into a guide which a user can refer to for issuing first credential.
These are fragmented pieces and I want to assemble them and structure it into a guide which a user can refer to for issuing first credential.

GitHub Repository Deployment Folder: https://github.com/inji/inji-certify/tree/master/deploy
